title: Cluster Management
desc: Configure Docker Swarm and K3s orchestration engines, expand cluster worker nodes, and manage resource isolation

form.type_hint: Supports lightweight Docker Swarm or production-grade K3s / Kubernetes engines
form.public_host_hint: External IP or domain used by players to access challenge containers
form.port_range_hint: Platform dynamically assigns exposed host ports within this range
form.swarm_api_url_hint: Local Docker socket or remote TCP daemon address
form.swarm_network_hint: Network name used for Swarm multi-host overlay communication
form.swarm_cert_path_hint: Path to client certs if mutual TLS authentication is required
form.k3s_master_url_hint: Endpoint of the K3s API server
form.k3s_namespace_hint: Kubernetes namespace where challenge pods are scheduled
form.k3s_kubeconfig_hint: Absolute path to kubeconfig credential file
form.isolation_hint: When enabled with worker nodes available, challenge containers are restricted to worker resource nodes only, preserving the master node
form.auto_migrate_hint: When a new resource node joins, automatically synchronize challenge images from the master node to the new node

nodes.title: Cluster Nodes Topology & Resource Allocation
nodes.name: Node Name
nodes.health_check_all_success: All nodes health check and resource reconciliation completed
nodes.remove_confirm: Are you sure you want to remove this node from the cluster? It will no longer host challenge containers.

add_modal.title: Expand Cluster - Add Node
add_modal.subtitle: Register a new physical or virtual machine into the cluster
add_modal.ip_address_required: Please enter a valid IP address
add_modal.is_resource_hint: Recommended. System will automatically migrate challenge images from the master node to this new node.
add_modal.enable_ssh_hint: System will inspect target hardware via SSH, auto-install Docker if missing, and join the Swarm cluster
add_modal.ssh_password_placeholder: Enter SSH password for the target machine
add_modal.ssh_password_required: SSH password is required when SSH provisioning is enabled
add_modal.auto_install_docker_hint: Docker Engine will be installed silently and TCP port 2375 will be enabled
add_modal.success_notice: Node added successfully! Automatic challenge image migration has been triggered.

edit_modal.title: Edit Cluster Node
edit_modal.subtitle: Modify node name, SSH credentials, role, and resource scheduling properties
edit_modal.is_resource_hint: When enabled, this node hosts and schedules dynamic challenge containers
edit_modal.worker_resource_hint: Worker nodes automatically serve as cluster resource nodes
edit_modal.ssh_password_placeholder: Leave empty to keep existing password
edit_modal.ssh_key_placeholder: Leave empty to keep existing private key
edit_modal.live_test_hint: Verifies network ping, SSH auth, and Docker status on the target node
edit_modal.success_notice: Node configuration updated and image topology synchronized

topology.title: Cluster Architecture & Topology
topology.hint: Visual topology of control plane and worker nodes, network status, and container placement. Supports zoom, pan, and dragging nodes.
topology.action_rejoin_success: Node successfully joined the Swarm cluster!
topology.tip_drag: Pan canvas or zoom with wheel; drag nodes to arrange
